This source project uses fictional records only. It tests the local experimental candidate and selects the unqualified `interactive-cv` filter supplied by a local-path installation.

## Try the three-page project

1. Copy this entire source folder to a normal project directory. Keep `career.json`, `lazy.yml`, `full.yml` and `detail.yml` beside the three QMD pages.
2. From that directory, install the local candidate with `quarto add "C:/path/to/interactive-cv" --no-prompt`. Replace the path with your actual local extension source. This tested local install matches the unqualified selector in `_quarto.yml`; an owner-qualified GitHub installation requires its matching selector and may install an earlier public version.
3. Use **Render Project** and Preview this page. Search public CV before loading any details, load one record, then load the complete catalogue before using advanced filters or exports.

[Full native record details](full.html) remain readable without JavaScript. [One native activity page](detail.html) shows the single-record form. All record destinations in this fictional catalogue point to the rendered full page.

The Word format uses the complete native source. A lazy browser print before full loading is a compact index; load the complete catalogue before using selected Word or PDF print preview.

Optional professional extraction requires the separately installed original Generative Websites filter selected in the project. Optional quote-request validation additionally requires the original Local AI Websites filter and a normal panel. Without those companions, this three-page CV remains usable and reports that the optional provider is unavailable. No model starts and no author-written JavaScript is required.

After changing permissions, **Render Project** and use the existing output audit before publication. A selected-page partial render does not update another page or its old managed resources.
